content.short: Perion DAO is an ecosystem of SubDAOs and modules that decentralizes decision-making while backing and building teams to accelerate Web3 gaming.
content.description: Perion DAO is an ecosystem comprised of multiple SubDAOs and modular components that work together to govern the broader Perion network. The design purposefully decentralizes and distributes decision-making across the Perion organization, enabling governance to occur at several levels and among distinct groups rather than concentrated in a single body. By coordinating SubDAOs and modules toward common goals, the system strives to sustain an effective, functional ecosystem capable of adapting to diverse requirements and fostering continuous progress within the Perion community.
content.meta: Perion DAO is an ecosystem of SubDAOs and modules that decentralizes decision-making within Perion. Discover Perion DAO and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
